records.question: Summarize all the rules in the fraud memo.
records.answer: The card fraud rules include R-101 Velocity, which declines the sixth and later card-not-present purchases and texts the customer when there are six or more within ten minutes [6]. R-104 Geo-jump declines the second purchase and places a soft block when two card-present purchases occur more than 500 miles apart within two hours [6]. R-110 First foreign use requires step-up verification in the app for a first-ever foreign purchase over $400 [6]. R-117 Merchant risk holds transactions for analyst review for up to four hours when the merchant is high-risk and the amount is over $250 [6]. R-122 New-device spend declines purchases over $1,000 within 24 hours of a new device enrolling and requires a call to Customer Care [6]. R-130 ATM pattern blocks ATM access for 24 hours after three or more out-of-network ATM withdrawals in one day at different terminals [6].
